project.title: Millennium Math Problems
project.shortDescription: 18 tasks · 1,286.0M tokens · 43.5h AI activity · API equivalent $728 (estimates) · Navier–Stokes research
project.readme:
# Millennium Math Problems

18 retrospective tasks. This Project is separate from the other portfolio Projects.

[Complete Git backup](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/project-history/math) · [Measurement method](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap#measurement-method)

Estimated task allocation: 1.286 B tokens, 43.5 h of activity after removing observed overlap, approximately $728 at Standard API rates. These are estimates, not human hours or an invoice.

## Budget by workstream

| Workstream | Tokens (M) | Allocated activity (h) | API equivalent (USD) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Mathematical research | 969.31 | 33.91 | $515.95 |
| Research communication | 313.72 | 9.36 | $207.19 |
| Project administration (AI-assisted) | 2.67 | 0.17 | $4.10 |
| Documentation (AI-assisted) | 0.25 | 0.02 | $0.44 |

Numerical and finite-model experiments are research artifacts, not a solution of the continuous Millennium problem. The withdrawal of normalization claims is preserved as MATH-14.

## Repositories

- [millennium-math-problems](https://github.com/fssrepository/millennium-math-problems)
- [myscoutee-roadmap](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap)
